scripts.update:data: npm run update:data:notes && npm run update:data:tasks
scripts.update:data:notes: npm run update:data:notes:collect && npm run update:data:notes:update
scripts.update:data:notes:collect: ob login --email $OBSIDIAN_EMAIL --password $OBSIDIAN_PASSWORD && ob sync-setup --vault 'Notes' --path ./tmp/vault --password $OBSIDIAN_PASSWORD && ob sync-config --path ./tmp/vault --mode mirror-remote && ob sync --path ./tmp/vault > /dev/null
scripts.update:data:tasks: npm run update:data:tasks:collect && npm run update:data:tasks:update
scripts.update:data:tasks:collect: td auth token $TODOOIST_AUTH_TOKEN; timestamp=$(date "+%Y-%m-%d ") && td activity --since $timestamp | grep completed | grep task | wc -l > tmp/tasks-completed
